items.title: Turn concept art into a functional game UI
items.excerpt: without leaving the terminal ⏩Give an agent your concept art and a short brief, and watch it build a working UI Toolkit main menu through the Unity CLI. The ...
items.rationale: Official Unity demo of an agent turning concept art and a short brief into a working UI Toolkit menu through the Unity CLI. A designer can try this workflow tomorrow.

items.title: Jagex responds to use of generative AI in RuneScape trailer made by "trusted external partner"
items.excerpt: Developer removes promotional material as it investigates situation, says it highlights "an issue with our own processes which we must address"
items.rationale: New incident: Jagex pulled a trailer from an external vendor after genAI artifacts were spotted, and admitted a process gap. That is a vendor-oversight lesson for art teams.

items.title: Fortnite Has Updated In-Game Art After Fans Discovered a Google Gemini AI Image Watermark
items.excerpt: Fortnite has quietly replaced a piece of in-game artwork after fans spotted its original version contained a Google Gemini AI watermark.
items.rationale: Fans found a Gemini provenance watermark in shipped Fortnite art and Epic quietly swapped the art. This shows how AI watermarks expose generated assets after release.

items.title: Hideo Kojima addresses AI after DLSS 5 hit Death Stranding 2, says "I don't much like the idea" of it taking work or control from artists
items.excerpt: Hideo Kojima addresses AI after DLSS 5 hit Death Stranding 2, says "I don't much like the idea" of it taking work or control from artists. But he thinks it's here to stay
items.rationale: Kojima's first statement on AI and artist control after DLSS 5 came to Death Stranding 2. It is a new first-party position from a top director, not a rehash of earlier DLSS 5 coverage.

items.title: Agentic Development in Unreal Engine with Rider | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
items.excerpt: Generic AI generates code and solves the easy part. The hard parts of Unreal Engine development—like Gameplay Ability System (GAS) bootstrap, build triage, D...
items.rationale: Unreal Fest session on using Rider's agents for the hard parts of UE work (GAS bootstrap, build triage). It is practical workflow guidance and separate from the earlier UE 5.8 MCP getting-started video.

dedup.note: Dropped as published duplicates: (1) Base-PS5 AI upscaling, both GamesIndustry.biz and Eurogamer (cluster c1). This is the same QSSR announcement already published 2026-10-02 (IGN 'Sony Announces QSSR'), and Wolverine/Yotei as launch titles is part of that announcement, not a new release. (2) The Verge 'An AI couldn't beat humans at StarCraft, so it decided to cheat'. This is the GPT-6 Astra StarCraft bot showdown already published 2026-09-30 (36kr), with no new release. It is the same angle as the Kotaku 'swaps in human-made bot' item dropped on 10-05. Any Inven 'Pluto' StarCraft item belongs to the same story and should also be dropped if it resurfaces; it is not in this pool. (3) Kotaku 'Zelda and Banjo Recompiled devs go to war with vibe-coded slopcomps' and RPS 'genAI speeds up PC ports claims are false, says Banjo Kazooie: Recompiled dev'. Both are reactions and extra reporting on the Recompiled-vs-vibe-coded-Banjo-Tooie story published 2026-10-03 (GamesRadar). (4) GameMeca 'Hive Axyl official launch'. This is the same launch as Inven 2026-09-30 (likely-repeat). Within-pool cluster c0 (RuneScape trailer): kept GamesIndustry.biz (carries Jagex's statement) and dropped the IGN version. This is a new incident (a trailer made by an external vendor), distinct from the 09-13 RuneScape copycat game. Not picked on merit: Kotaku Soccerina of Time vibe-coded romhack (a fourth vibe-code backlash card in a few days; ranked below the dev-tool picks), AUTOMATON Morpho Reverie (AI is only the narrative theme), Kotaku Loish (artist opinion; already passed on 10-05).
